summary: We choose a project that involves searching for locations on Earth that share the same conditions as those found on another planet—in this case, Mars. To illustrate this, we created a scale model representing a site we identified that possesses these same conditions.
details: We choose a project that involves searching for locations on Earth that share the same conditions as those found on another planet—in this case, Mars. This project aims to establish a foundation for studying Mars here on Earth, so that future travel to the Red Planet can be undertaken with the knowledge of how to survive there. Furthermore, through the creation of a scale model, we hope to help young children understand the characteristics of Mars and how similar it can be to Earth.
